question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution mentions that ‘The State shall endeavour to organise agriculture and animal husbandry on modern and scientific lines’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 48**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 48** of the Indian Constitution mandates that 'The State shall endeavour to organise agriculture and animal husbandry on modern and scientific lines'.
 
• This directive principle aims to promote the use of modern techniques and scientific advancements in agriculture and animal husbandry.
